title: Machine learning relates personal and environmental measurements to thermal-comfort votes
summary: Participants’ comfort votes were compared with measurements collected under controlled temperature conditions using leave-one-subject-out evaluation. Transfer to other populations, buildings or uncontrolled settings and improved comfort from using the models are not established.
ai_technology: Machine-learning models related environmental and physiological sensor measurements and personal characteristics to participants’ thermal-comfort votes.
